notes.title: 4.22.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Halved Machine Gun's ammo consumption
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Graveyard special room softlock from all directions
[*]Made changes to the level loading system that should prevent the bug causing players to load into unintended areas
[/list]

notes.title: 4.21.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[list]
[*]Gravestone’s volleys now spin, eliminating consistent openings in bullet patterns
[*]Reduced number of bullets in Gravestone’s volleys from 20 → 16
[*]Camera now pans less in boss entrance rooms
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed special room in the Graveyard that could result in a softlock
[*]Fixed additional visual bugs related to the logs between rooms
[*]Fixed bug allowing interactions with transport stumps after interacting, pausing, then unpausing
[/list]

notes.title: 4.20.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed item given to player by parachute Beekeeper Shroomie
[*]Added SMG to the Forest
[*]Added Poison Dart Gun to the Forest
[*]Added Tommy Gun to the Graveyard
[*]Added Machine Gun to the Meadow
[*]New Boss in the Graveyard! His name is Gravestone — please be nice to him, he’s new
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Shotgun DPS lowered from 19.6 → 16
[*]Proton Gun bullets fired per ammo consumed reduced from 6 → 4 (DPS unaffected)
[*]Spud Gun bullets per ammo increased from 2 → 3 (DPS increased from 3 → 4.5)
[*]Honey Mortar damage per blast increased from 6 → 10 (DPS 22.5 → 37.5)
[*]Honey Mortar ammo consumption increased from 5 → 6
[*]Buffed Grenade Launcher damage per explosion from 15 → 20
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug causing 'E' interact indicator to disappear from the Shroom Exchange deposit after first interacting
[*]Fixed bug related to run stats being reset when they shouldn't have been
[*]Shotgun minimum spread set back to 25 degrees
[*]Fixed bug causing jittery and slow movement through some corridors
[*]Fixed bug responsible for some bugged corridors
[/list]

notes.title: 4.17.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added credits to the main menu
[*]More Forest rooms!
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Default stick damage buffed from 0.5 → 1
[*]Stock Market reward for beating a dungeon and beating the game has been lowered
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bugged super explosive barrels not having collision
[*]Fixed error occurring in rooms without spawn points
[*]Fixed walkable water in a Meadow room
[*]Made the teased items in a Meadow room unreachable
[*]Fixed bug where current health could exceed max health when losing or gaining a max health modifier
[*]Boss loading bug should finally be resolved
[*]Fixed misplaced explosive barrel in a Graveyard room
[*]The saving and loading system has been refactored so the bug causing the armory to misbehave should finally have been fixed!
[/list]

notes.title: 4.14.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[list]
[*]Health drops spawned by Plastic Fangs now appear at the player’s location instead of the center of the room
[*]Fixed typo in Plastic Fangs description
[*]Donation box name now switches to “Donation Box” immediately upon donating
[*]Made donation text boxes narrower
[*]Enemy bee bullets are now green to reflect their poisonous nature
[*]Bee bullets retain a red glow to help distinguish them from player bullets — may be adjusted further if still unclear
[*]Reworked Game Over canvas layout to allow for a larger inventory view
[*]Changed Albino parachute indicator from pink to green
[*]Shot leading now applies per volley rather than per bullet
[*]Modifiers can now increase melee hitbox size (currently one modifier grants this; more coming soon!)
[*]Reflected or bounced bullets now convert to standard type (removes homing/wave effects)
[*]You can now hold the roll button and Shroomie will roll as soon as he's able
[*]Added roll cooldown modifiers — one item is available in each area
[*]Reworked some crowded rooms
[*]Added SFX to stump hatch when firing
[/list]

[h2]Capgear![/h2]
[list]
[*]New equipment type: Capgear (only one can be equipped at a time)
[*]Capgear changes Shroomie’s cap, similar to facegear and headgear
[*]Current capgears: Red Mushroom, Green Mushroom, and a new one
[*]Buffed capgear effects due to mutual exclusivity
[/list]

[h2]The Shroom Exchange! (Gambling)[/h2]
[list]
[*]New building in the HUB near the bank
[*]Works like a bank, but tied to your performance in a run
[*]Withdrawals and deposits are only available at the Exchange
[*]Stock value increases or decreases based on your run outcome
[*]Dying early can cause major losses — be warned!
[*]Funds must be withdrawn from Exchange to deposit in the bank
[*]Experimental feature — feedback welcome!
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Eraser consumable radius doubled (visual unchanged)
[*]All enemies drop fewer acorns; bears now drop 10 (was 0)
[*]Honey Dipper projectile damage: 1 → 3
[*]Magic Sword projectile damage: 2 → 7
[*]Sword of Light projectile damage: 3 → 12
[*]Iron Slug modifier bullet growth: 2 → 1
[*]Grenade Launcher damage: 2 → 15
[*]Hard Hat and Knight’s Helmet defense buffs increased
[*]Pale Stumpling damage slightly increased
[*]Pale Stumpling health: 200 → 150
[*]Giant Pale Stumpling health: 500 → 400
[*]Bear health: 300 → 220
[*]Bear speed: 4 → 5
[*]Bear ranged bullets now pierce
[*]Bear ranged bullet damage: 1 → 3
[*]Bear ranged bullets no longer slow
[*]Proton Gun bullets per ammo: 8 → 6 (DPS unchanged)
[*]Bee Blaster bullets per volley: 10 → 8 (DPS: 28 → 22)
[*]Ectoplasma Gun damage per bullet: 1.2 → 1.3
[*]Nail Gun damage per bullet: 1.5 → 1.75
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed rare null reference exception related to level loading
[*]Fixed bug preventing some transport hatches from opening (notably in one Forest room)
[*]Changed wall collider type — should reduce wall-sticking issues
[*]Fixed layering issues with Squashlings
[*]Bubble bullets now pop with a pink effect (was yellow)
[*]Hive-spawned enemies now count toward the room’s enemy pool (except in boss rooms)
[/list]

notes.title: 04.10.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made corridor visuals on the minimap and map twice as thick
[*] The “Play” button on the menu is no longer defaulted to active, meaning it will animate when hovered over with the mouse like the other buttons
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Buffed albino military upgrades, increasing all spawn chances across the board for all levels
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed another case in which donation boxes could take your money after you donated
[*] Fixed bug causing strange movement between rooms if you were far away from the log when interacting with it (your location relative to it when interacting is no longer a factor)
[*] Fixed bug causing you to be able to start an attack while paused
[/list]

notes.title: 04.09.25 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed more dancing graves from graveyard rooms
[*] Ghost bullets now deal damage
[*] Fixed null reference sometimes happening with enemy homing bullets
[*] Fixed null reference sometimes occurring when using transport hatches between dungeons
[/list]
